about: The studio's video categories (vinari.ge/studio), the single source of their ids. The site keeps a copy of the id list (web/api/studio.js CATEGORIES, web/studio.html CATS, scripts/studio-dev.mjs) and shows the labels, which are the app's own names for its features (the owner, 2026-10-06: "name them as in the app, I cannot tell what is what"); tools/ci/prompt.mjs puts one category's facts, screens and earlier videos into the brief; tools/build-index.mjs checks a spec's "category". Facts are short English, true to the app (Marketing/VINARI — app brief.md, docs/pricing.md, the store texts and the release notes of each update in VINARI_STATE.md, all in the main Vinari repo): the cloud may use nothing outside them. After every big app update the facts are brought up to date here and in the "whatsnew" category, and the site's copy in step. Order matters: the site lists the categories in this order and the dice breaks ties by it: the app's main features first, in the owner's order of 2026-10-06 (QR card, parking, VIN scanner, diagnostics, OBD scanner, navigator, calendar), then the other features, then car knowledge, general and the announcement. "feature": false = not one feature (a general video may not list it among the features it shows). "dice": false = the dice (no category, no topic) never rolls it: it is asked for on purpose. "diceEvery": n = the dice gives this category every n-th roll (2: every other dice film; the ledger's "from": "dice" counts the rolls); the other rolls take the least-used category among the rest. "tipEvery": n (a bank category) = when none of the category's last n - 1 films used a practical tip (a bank fact with "tip": true), the dice's offer is tips only, so about every n-th car-knowledge film is a reel-style tip that opens on a question (the owner, 2026-10-06); a typed idea or a redo decides for itself. "allfacts": true = the brief also sends the cloud to the categories file for the facts of the features the film shows. "words": case-insensitive patterns that read the category from a topic typed without one (the longest total match wins; general only when nothing else matches; a "bank" category never when the topic names the app, and a tie between it and a feature goes to the feature). "signature": the scene types whose first scene may not repeat the staging of the category's last 2 films (tools/ci/visual.mjs; empty = every staged type). "bank": the category is general car knowledge from a sourced fact bank ("carinfo", the owner 2026-10-05): its facts are not here but in the file named (ci/carinfo-sources.json: "lines", one "<id>: <plain Georgian>" each, and by id each fact's source, theme, app link, tip flag and real sounds), so this file stays short for the briefs that read it whole; the brief offers a few themes per film, not the whole bank, and --record --facts stores which facts a film used. The App Store gate (the owner, 2026-10-06: the navigator and the OBD scanner are shown faded and refused until the update is public): "release": "1.0.4" = the category is locked until the App Store's live version ("store".lookup, Apple's public lookup, results[0].version) is at least that, compared part by part (1.0.10 > 1.0.4); a lookup that fails keeps it locked. "after": {"<version>": {...}} = from that live version on, the keys it names replace the category's own (facts, never, screens, tier ...): what becomes true at the release (the engine's "the app does not plug into the car", whatsnew's new content). Nothing is deployed when Apple releases: tools/ci/release.mjs asks Apple for the dice and the brief, web/api/studio.js for the site (cached "store".minutes), and both flip by themselves. The brief never sends Claude here: prompt.mjs writes out/ci/categories.now.json, this file with the gate applied (locked and retired categories gone, "after" merged), and the brief names that file. "retired": categories taken out of the studio (id: its old label): no new film is made in them, but old films keep the id (specs and the ledger are history), build-index still takes it and the site still shows the old label (price, customs and chart: the owner, 2026-10-06, "rubbish, make it simpler"; honest: 2026-09-28).

categories.label: QR ბარათი
facts: A windshield card, printed on A4 in black and white.
A passer-by scans it and taps one of three reasons, word for word: "მანქანა გზას მიკეტავს", "შუქები ანთია", "მანქანასთან რაღაც ხდება". The owner gets a push.
No number is shown anywhere, neither the passer-by's nor the owner's, and the plate is not on the card.
Quiet hours are optional and off by default.
Revoked in one tap; a revoked code never opens again.
never: "quiet at night" as if always on (quiet hours are off until switched on)
a promise that the owner comes (that is up to them)

categories.label: პარკინგი
facts: Remembers where you parked, offline.

categories.label: VIN სკანერი
facts: Add a car by photographing its VIN: the app reads it, on the phone.
No typing 17 characters by hand.
It is how the free car gets added.
Reading the VIN (make, model, year, engine) works without internet: the database is built into the app.
Japanese home-market cars have a frame (chassis) number instead of a VIN, like GRX130-6012345: the app accepts it too.
The auction record is found by the VIN, never by a frame number.

a frame number that finds an auction record
"without internet" for the price or the auction record (both are online)

categories.label: დიაგნოსტიკა
categories.tier: the trouble-code lookup FREE, the sound check and the three questions VINARI+
facts: VINARI+: records 4 seconds of engine sound and says: knock, squeal or hum.

VINARI+: three questions tell you which of 11 mechanic types you need, in drivers' words (კარობკა, ჟესტიანშიკი, მალიარი ...). The suspension mechanic is „სავალი ნაწილის ხელოსანი“ in a film (the app's own label on 13-diagnosis is the Russianism the owner bans: a film never says or writes it).
The sound check never names a part and never gives a diagnosis: a guess, not a diagnosis.

Free, and without internet: trouble codes (OBD-II) explained in Georgian. Type the code a scanner or a mechanic gave you, like P0420, and see what it means, how urgent it is and which mechanic you need.
9 533 codes. A code typed any way is found: P0420, p0420, 0420, or with a Georgian or Russian letter (პ0420, Р0420).
An example, word for word: P0420 is "კატალიზატორის ეფექტიანობა დაბალია"; the card says the car usually drives normally, but the inspection may be a problem.
Urgency has four steps: სასწრაფოდ, ერთ კვირაში, ორ კვირაში, კომფორტი.
The app does not plug into the car: you type the code, it explains it.

"დიაგნოზი" or any medical word as the app's claim

categories.label: OBD სკანერი
categories.tier: VINARI+ (a sample scan is free; typing a code stays free under დიაგნოსტიკა)
facts: Plug an ELM327 adapter into the car's OBD-II port: the app reads the check engine light, the trouble codes, the VIN, the battery and the readiness, then answers „შეგიძლია იარო?“ in plain Georgian.
On iPhone the adapter must be Wi-Fi or Bluetooth LE; a Classic Bluetooth adapter (PIN 1234) or a cable does not work.
It reads the engine and the emissions only, not ABS, the airbags or the body: a mechanic has the final word.
Also live data, a scan history, sending the codes and the verdict to a mechanic as text („ხელოსანს გაუგზავნე“), and clearing codes: the light goes out, but if the cause stays, the code comes back.

The pre-purchase check („ყიდვამდე შემოწმება“), with the same adapter: were the codes cleared recently (a battery change leaves the same trace, and the screen says so), permanent codes that clearing cannot remove, does the engine unit's VIN match the papers, and that VIN's auction record.
Inspection readiness: when every monitor has finished, the screen says „ტექინსპექტირებისთვის მზადაა“.
On the დიაგნოსტიკა screen (21-obd-hub) the scanner's card sits on top, with „ხმა და სიმპტომები“ (VINARI+) and „კოდი ხელით ჩაწერე“ (free) under it.
Without VINARI+ a sample scan shows what a scan looks like.
never: ABS, the airbags, the body or the brakes read by the scanner

categories.label: ნავიგატორი
categories.tier: VINARI+ (both voices to hear and one demo drive are free)
facts: A navigator that speaks Georgian: Nelson (ნელსონი) or Alice (ალისა) calls out the turns, whatever the app's language.
Map, search, routes and voice are on the phone, so it works with no signal. Georgia's roads only, on iPhone.
Roundabout exits are counted; lanes, bridges and speed cameras are spoken. Street names are an optional download.
With the screen locked the voice keeps guiding; the next turn shows on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.
Home, work or „დედასთან“ starts with one tap and a 4-second countdown, also from the app icon or the widget.
Arrival times include the usual traffic for that hour; there is no live traffic. Camera data comes from OpenStreetMap and may be incomplete: road signs come first.
It has its own tab in the bottom bar: მთავარი, კალენდარი, პარკინგი, ნავიგატორი. Home asks „სად მივდივართ?“.
Its settings switch on or off „იუმორი“ and the voices' own stories („ნელსონის ამბები“, „ალისას ამბები“) (20-nav-streets-settings).
Without VINARI+ you can hear both voices and take one demo drive.
never: live traffic or traffic jams
any country but Georgia, or anything about the occupation line (keep politics out)
a speed camera promised everywhere (the data may be incomplete)
"free" for the navigator (only the voices to hear and one demo drive are)
a phone held in the hand while driving: it sits in a holder and the voice guides

categories.label: კალენდარი
categories.tier: the car's own two dates and their reminders FREE, the calendar VINARI+
facts: Every car has two dates of its own: the inspection (ტექინსპექტირება) and the LPG cylinder (LPG ბალონი). Setting and changing them, and their reminders, are free.

The calendar is VINARI+: every date on one month grid, with your own entries. Its types: oil (ზეთი), inspection (ტექინსპექტირება), tyres (საბურავები), the mechanic (ხელოსანი), insurance (დაზღვევა), parking (პარკინგი), the LPG cylinder (LPG ბალონი), the driving licence (მართვის მოწმობა), or anything in your own words.

Adding one: in the calendar you pick what to do ("რა უნდა გააკეთო": e.g. ხელოსანი), write it in your own words if you like (e.g. "საბურავების შეცვლა გიორგისთან"), pick the date and tap "მზადაა"; the reminder then comes on its own.
It reminds 7, 3 or 1 days before: you choose.
The morning reminder comes at 09:00 unless you move it (06:00 to 12:00, in settings) and on every step; the 19:30 evening repeat comes only 1 day before and on the day, and can be switched off.
Local: scheduled on the phone, no server.
The free home screen widget counts the days to the nearest date, e.g. "ტექინსპექტირება 53 დღე".
never: 19:30 over the 7- or 3-day step
fines
the test entry "ტესტი, ვაკე" on 03-calendar-day

categories.label: ვიჯეტები
categories.tier: FREE (a widget shows what your plan shows)
facts: Home screen widgets, free for everyone. A widget never goes online: it shows what the app already knows, and a tap opens that place in the app.
Small, "ვადა": the nearest date and the days left, e.g. "ტექინსპექტირება 53 დღე". The same on the lock screen: a ring, a short line or one line of text.
Medium, "მანქანა": your car card: the plate, the market price with its change, and the next date.
Large, "გარაჟი": up to three cars with their prices and dates, and where you parked.
Calendar, medium or large: this month as a grid, today ringed, the days with a date marked, and the next dates beside it or under it.
On the free plan a widget shows one car and its own two dates (the inspection and the LPG cylinder); more cars, your calendar entries and the parked spot come with VINARI+.
The look is the app's: white cards, black ink, clean and calm.
never: a widget that goes online or refreshes a price by itself
something a widget does not show (customs, the QR card, the chart)
"free" for the VINARI+ things a widget can show (more cars, calendar entries, the parked spot)
an app screen passed off as a widget: draw the widget itself in your Film scene
Android, Google Play or a date for either

facts: The wallet: your budget goes in, the max safe bid comes out, after ocean, port, fees and customs.
The lari rate comes from the National Bank (online).
A US auction damage record by VIN: what was damaged, which document, when.
The database is incomplete and the screen says so: "not found" does not mean "never crashed". Two of five VINs have no page at all.

the app, its name or a screen when no fact the film uses links a feature (then it is a film without the app)

facts: An announcement film about the newest update: one new thing shown well, or two or three in one everyday story. Each item keeps its own category's facts and never-list too (widgets, engine, vin, reminders, in the categories file the brief names).

Home screen widgets, free: the nearest date with the days left ("ტექინსპექტირება 53 დღე"), your car card (the plate, the market price and its change, the next date), the garage (up to three cars and where you parked), a month calendar, and the lock screen. Garage: swipe a car to the left to edit or delete it.
A shorter first start, and more settings: the reminder time, the evening repeat, vibration apart from the sounds, the main car, your fuel, and a data export.
When a new version is out, a calm bar in the app says so.

VINARI+ is now monthly or yearly: $9.99 a month (about 26.99 ₾) or $49.99 a year (about 130.99 ₾; the lari figure is an estimate at today's rate, the charge is in dollars), and the yearly plan starts with a 7-day free trial. The screen compares: one month is about 7 liters of petrol at today's price, the whole year about one tank.
